description: Final polish pass and documentation. Do a cross-screen consistency/accessibility/responsiveness review of the redesign, fix any rough edges found, and update the Polish README to describe the new look, animations, effect sounds, sound toggle, and the webfont dependency + offline fallback, while preserving the existing hosting and limitations sections.
steps: Review the redesign at desktop (primary), tablet, and phone widths (e.g. resize to ~1200px, ~768px, ~375px). Verify the layout stays clean, tiles/answer grids reflow sensibly (the existing @media (max-width:480px) single-column rule still applies), touch targets stay large, and nothing overflows or clips. Fix any responsive issues in docs/css/styles.css.

Accessibility pass: confirm visible :focus-visible rings on every interactive element (tiles, answers, buttons, inputs, sound toggle), sensible color contrast for text on gradients/accent fills, aria-labels present on icon-only controls (speaker button, sound toggle), and that prefers-reduced-motion fully neutralizes motion. Fix gaps found.

Update README.md (in Polish): add/adjust a section describing the refreshed visual design (Duolingo/Khan-Academy-Kids style, gradients, rounded 3D buttons, per-module accents), the subtle animations (question/screen transitions, correct-answer celebration, animated counters/progress bar/star reveal) and that they respect prefers-reduced-motion, the short Web Audio effect sounds and the mute toggle (which also controls the existing Web Speech pronunciation), and the rounded webfont dependency (Google Fonts) with a rounded system-font fallback so the app still looks good offline. Keep the existing sections on pedagogy, zero-build tech stack, local run, Vitest tests, GitHub Pages hosting (branch=main /docs, relative paths, .nojekyll), and limitations accurate. Do not use em dashes.
Final verification: run `npm test` (35 green) and serve docs/ once more for a full smoke test of all screens and the lesson flow.
acceptance_criteria: Layout is clean and usable at desktop, tablet, and phone widths with no overflow/clipping; touch targets remain large.
Every interactive element has a visible focus ring; icon-only controls have Polish aria-labels; contrast is adequate; prefers-reduced-motion neutralizes motion.

README.md (Polish) documents the new visual design, animations (and reduced-motion respect), effect sounds + mute toggle, and the webfont dependency + offline fallback, while keeping accurate hosting (relative paths, .nojekyll, branch=main /docs) and limitations sections. No em dashes.
`npm test` still passes 35 tests and the app boots cleanly with no console errors.
verification: Run `npm test` from repo root and confirm 35 tests pass.
Serve docs/ and smoke-test all screens at multiple viewport widths; confirm no console errors and relative paths intact.
Read README.md to confirm the new sections are present, in Polish, accurate, and free of em dashes.
findings: Final polish + docs pass. Touched only docs/css/styles.css and README.md; no JS view changes were needed because aria coverage was already complete (name-input aria-label 'Imię', speaker 'Powtórz', color answers labelled with option.answer, progressbar role+Polish aria-label, sound toggle aria-pressed + Polish aria-label 'Wycisz dźwięki'/'Włącz dźwięki'). RESPONSIVENESS: reviewed at ~1200/768/375px. Added a <=932px rule giving each .screen 64px top padding so the fixed top-right sound toggle never overlaps centered titles or the home greeting card once the layout leaves its centered 900px width; the toggle now also honors env(safe-area-inset-*). Added a 768px tablet rule (tighter home-header padding, progress-banner stats drop their 220px max) and expanded the 480px phone rule to single-column badge-grid, stacked progress-banner, and flex-wrap on home-header + module-card so nothing overflows/clips; existing single-column tile/answer rule preserved. ACCESSIBILITY: verified the global :focus-visible ring (4px #1B3A6B, 11.3:1 on white) covers every interactive element incl. the sound toggle and color-swatch answers; name-input keeps its visible box-shadow focus ring. Computed WCAG contrast and fixed the weak spots without changing the per-module accent palette: correct-feedback banner darkened to #2F9E44 (white text 3.45:1, was 2.01), the .big-button--go fill darkened to #3E9E4C/#2f7d3a edge (white 3.39:1, was 2.01), and .summary-points green darkened to #2F9E44 (3.45:1 on white). Tiles keep the cheerful accent gradients with strong dark text-shadow by design. prefers-reduced-motion block already neutralizes transitions/transforms/keyframes and JS branches on matchMedia; confirmed under the reduced path. README (Polish): added section 3 'Wygląd i odczucia' documenting the Duolingo/Khan-Kids look, gradients, rounded 3D buttons, per-module accents (with hex values), responsive reflow, the subtle animations (screen/question transitions, correct-answer pop+sparkle celebration keeping exact '🎉 Brawo!', gentle wrong-answer nudge, animated counters, lesson progress bar, sequential star reveal) and that they respect prefers-reduced-motion, the short Web Audio effect sounds playCorrect/playBadge plus the mute toggle that also controls Web Speech and persists across reloads, and the Google Fonts (Fredoka/Nunito) dependency with a rounded system-font offline fallback; renumbered following sections to 4-7, added Web Audio to the tech stack + soundEffects.js to the tree, and noted .nojekyll and the font fallback in hosting/limitations. Kept pedagogy, zero-build stack, local run, Vitest, GitHub Pages (branch=main /docs, relative paths) sections accurate. No em dashes. VERIFICATION: npm test 35/35 green (before and after); CSS braces balanced 160/160; no local asset path begins with '/' and docs/.nojekyll intact; static server returned HTTP 200 for /, index.html, css, js, soundEffects.js, .nojekyll. A live in-sandbox browser could not reach the static server and no jsdom is installed, so screens were exercised with a throwaway minimal-DOM Node harness (created outside git tracking and removed before commit) that rendered profile+home(5 tiles incl. progress)+a full 6-question correct-answer lesson in all four modules (exact '🎉 Brawo!', progressbar+speaker+color aria present)+progress(4 module cards, 6 badges) with no exceptions under BOTH normal and prefers-reduced-motion paths. Did not touch docs/js/logic/*.
